description: Census of what the corpus has captured over a bounded window of sealed bonds: per lane (LLM_WEIGHTS, LLVM_IR, LLVM_IR_I64, AUDIO_SPEECH) the bond count and exact-orbit-closure count, plus distinct spatial sectors. Stateless: pin at_seq for a byte-stable census on every cell, or omit it to read the moving head.

at_seq.description: decimal string, caller-pinned stream position; same value = same bytes

limit.description: decimal string, window size up to 8192

source.description: optional lane filter: LLM_WEIGHTS, LLVM_IR, LLVM_IR_I64, AUDIO_SPEECH

name: corpus_capability_map
